rows.probe_evidence: script: 1,422 pp, 4,024,971 chars, nm_const_2026.pdf; 'Sec. 18. [Due process; equal protection' p. 511
rows.instruction_problems: (1) The first section of each article reads 'Section 1. [' and not 'Sec. 1. [', so the stated regex 'Sec\. N\. \[' misses every § 1. (2) 'Locate the ARTICLE heading' is ambiguous. A case-insensitive grep for 'ARTICLE VII' gets 17 hits, mostly annotation references ('Article VII of the New Probate Code'). The real heading reads 'ARTICLE VII Elective Franchise Section 1. [' (p. 1040).
rows.suggested_fix: Section regex '(?:Sec\.|Section) N\. \['; locate the article by its heading plus title (e.g. 'ARTICLE VII\s+Elective Franchise') or by the first 'Section 1. [' that follows it.
